name: @orchestra/resonance-labs-core
description: resonance labs internal source — compliance validation, site build, and public export pipeline

scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run build:site && npm run build:public
scripts.preview: npm run build:site && DIST=dist-site PREVIEW=1 node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.preview:ghpages: npm run build && mkdir -p /tmp/ghpages/resonance-labs && cp -r dist-public/. /tmp/ghpages/resonance-labs/ && DIST=/tmp/ghpages BASE=/resonance-labs PREVIEW=1 node scripts/dev.mjs
